sourceDescription: Built-in imagegen;144px anatomical density, invariant runtime scale. Helmet plume motion has a measured4 atlas-pixel visible-height span (2 world pixels); physical idle height still passes the default3px gate. No silhouette fitting or breathing scale animation.
